title: What Happens When You Crack Your Knuckles?
sources: Kawchuk et al. 2015, PLOS ONE: Real-Time Visualization of Joint Cavitation via MRI
Donald Unger, MD, 2009 Ig Nobel Prize in Medicine: Knuckle cracking and arthritis in a 60-year experiment

lines.text: What actually happens when you crack your knuckles?
Most people think your bones are grinding together, but that's a total myth.
Inside your joint, thick fluid suddenly drops in pressure as you stretch,
forming tiny gas bubbles that instantly collapse and pop!
One doctor cracked one hand for sixty years to prove it does zero damage. So crack away!
